title: Cambridge_data
description: Cambridge fNIRS dataset containing functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) neuroimaging data acquired from participants during cognitive tasks. This is a raw fNIRS dataset mirrored from OpenNeuro (ds007714). The dataset includes optical neuroimaging measurements using fNIRS technology. For complete information about participants, experimental design, data collection methods, study protocols, authors, and funding, please refer to the original dataset on OpenNeuro at https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds007714.
